# Anchorflow

> Free, in-browser tool that pins GitHub Actions to full commit SHAs and audits the workflow. Paste a .github/workflows/*.yml file; get it back with every action pinned (original tag kept as a trailing comment, the format Dependabot reads), GITHUB_TOKEN permissions listed per job, template-injection sinks flagged, and a red/green diff of the changed uses: lines. Each pin has a receipt with the GitHub API calls made and a git ls-remote command to verify it. The workflow never leaves the browser; the only network requests are optional, read-only, unauthenticated GETs to api.github.com naming the action and tag. No account, no install. Built by Nor AI.

- Tool: https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow

## Guides

- [How to pin GitHub Actions to a commit SHA](https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow/learn/pin-github-actions-to-commit-sha)
- [GITHUB_TOKEN permissions: least privilege](https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow/learn/github-token-permissions)
- [Template injection in GitHub Actions](https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow/learn/github-actions-template-injection)
- [pull_request_target and workflow_run](https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow/learn/pull-request-target-security)
- [actions/checkout persist-credentials](https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow/learn/checkout-persist-credentials)
- [Verify a pinned action SHA yourself](https://anchor.norai.tech/tools/anchorflow/learn/verify-pinned-action-sha)

## Limits

- One workflow file at a time, up to 256 KiB and 2,000 uses: lines.
- Does not follow reusable workflows or composite actions into other repositories.
- GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated API requests per hour per IP; refs beyond that are left unpinned and marked.
- A pinned SHA freezes code; it does not prove the action is safe.
